Adding the finance checklist and a brief mapping template. James — answering Sergio's questions inline:

- Legal entity name: please confirm the exact legal name to appear on the vendor record (as on W9).
- Invoice/PO fields: our AP system prefers separate columns (PO_REF + INV_NO). If you send a single concatenated field occasionally, we can accept it but will need a stable delimiter (e.g., "#" or ":").
- Payment reference: max 35 chars recommended; we'll truncate beyond that which can break automated matching.

- PO must be present on invoice in PO_REF column or on the invoice PDF text.
- Invoice number must be unique per vendor.
- For credits/refunds, include original INV_NO and a short note in description field.
